importing and exporting Hotkey/Layout settings

Hello

I post latest script for exporting and importing hotkey or layout settings.

Taking backup of plist file before executing this script is recommended.
It's optimized for v4.2. it may not work with older and newer than v4.2.
Importing layout settings is enabled for 'New' or 'Open' documents after execution.

download:http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=29

and this is also sample for using 'OS.system()' function and 'defaults' CLI command.
